name: síodh
text: síodh is a MacKillop variant spelling of sidh. The form appears in older Irish sources as a phonetic rendering of the sídhe headword. The full record of the sídhe tradition sits under the headword sídhe.

attributes.attribute: Variant spelling of sidh; pointer to sídhe headword

key_results: Signpost cites sídhe as the canonical headword.
